runs.scenario: If the CNE portal is unreadable and there is no proclamation, Primicias could report Muñoz leading at 91% processed while Teleamazonas reports another candidate leading at 96%. Both reports meet the threshold, but the criterion does not say whether to use the first qualifying count, the most complete count, or a preferred outlet.
